### Parse(string)

Reads a versioned compiler graph without executing extension code or resolving managed types.

```csharp
public static ExtensionSchemaGraph Parse(string encoded)
```

Parameters:

`encoded` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The base64-encoded graph from generated Ankus metadata.

Returns: [ExtensionSchemaGraph](/api/ankus.pgconfig.extensionschemagraph/)

The validated immutable graph.

Exceptions:

- [FormatException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.formatexception): The framing, text, declarations, dependency order or family ownership is invalid.

Decoded graphs are limited to 32 MiB and 100,000 declarations. Dependencies must refer to preceding declarations.
